route_title: 12-layer ZnS/ZnSe stack with 850nm thickness cap and peak re-initialization
compilation_rationale: Compiled per explicit 12-layer ZnS/ZnSe sequence on Ge. Coherent smatrix solver selected. Thickness bounds 100-850 nm applied to all layers. Learning rate scaled to 0.03 per instruction. Spectral range 3000-11000 nm sampled at 2001 points. Target bands mapped to separate mean and worst-case transmittance objectives. Reporting requirements treated as downstream outputs.
